༄༅/ /gnas lugs sgom pa'i lhan thabs yid kyi mun sel bi dza ha ra/ /bla ma mchog gsum gdod ma'i mgon po dang / /dbyer med nges pa'i blo yis phyag

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnas lugs sgom pa'i lhan thabs yid kyi mun sel bi dza ha ra// bla ma mchog gsum gdod ma'i mgon po dang / /dbyer med nges pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal nas/ /dran pa gso ba'i zla zer cung zad spel/ /yid kyi rtsa kor dga' bder spyod gyur cig /'dir gnas lugs kyi sgom rim la nye bar mkho bar cung zad brjod na/ sems don sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom rim nyid bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la chos thams cad sems su bstan pa/ sems don ma sgom pa'i skyon/ sgom pa'i yon tan gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ spyir 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems yin te/ sa bcu par/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras sogs/ gur las rin chen sems las sogs/ sambu ṭar phyi dang nang gi sogs/ ri khrod dbang phyug gi chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ /ces so/ /de ltar yin na phyi rol gzung yul sna tshogs dngos por snang ba ji yin zhe na/ sems rang gi gnas lugs la ma rig pa gnyis snang gi bag chags goms pas 'khrul snang ste/ lang gshegs las/ bag chags kyis ni sogs/ saṃ ṭir chos rnams sems kyi sogs/ dper na rlung gi chu dkrugs pas rdor gyur ba lta bu ste/ sa ra has/ rlung gi chu la sogs/ rgyas par mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang por gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don ma bsgom na thos bsam sgom gsum la ji tsam brtson kyang mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi thob par dpe du ma'i sgo nas gsungs te/ sdong po bkod par/ yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di sogs rnam par rol pa'i mdor/ sems kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs na sems can rnam par rtog pa'i kha thabs su song bas khams gsum kun tu 'khor zhing rgyu drug tu 'khyams pa yin no/ /zhes dang spyod 'jug tu/ sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i sogs/ gang gi chos kyi sogs/ bsam gtan ma bsgom na shes rab mi skye/

de ma skyes na byang chub mi thob te/ bshes spring du/ bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med/ /ces so/ /des na tshul khrims la gnas nas thos bsam bsgom gsum la rim bzhin sbyor dgos te/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang sogs/ gsum pa ni/ yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa'i bsod nams ni dpag tu med de/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i mdor/ bskal par nyan pa bas se gol gtogs pa tsam ting 'dzin bsgom pa bsod nams che bar gsungs la/ gtsug tor chen po'i mdo dang / rtog pa rgyas pa'i mdo las kyang gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'dod yon la zhen pa bzlog pa dang / the tshom gcod pa dang / mngon shes dang ting nge 'dzin 'char snying rje skye/ gdul bya yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par nus pa sogs yon tan mang ngo / /sdud par bsam gtan gyi ni sogs/ sa yi snying po 'khor lo bcu pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ bsam gtan gyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa la/ thun mong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam zhag mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgom rim bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin spyi'i sdud byed ngos bzung zhing dgos pa gcod pa dang / zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnam gzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg pa che chung gi ting nge 'dzin sgrub tshul ci rigs ni gar yang bshad kyang / yongs grags ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam dbye ston byed la mdo phyogs kyi gzhung rnams gsal bar snang zhing / de yang dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs mdo du ma dang / byams chos dang / thogs med kyi sa sde rnams dang / mngon pa kun las btus/ de dag gi don bsdus shānti pa'i sher phyin man ngag dang / sgom rim gsum sogs grags che zhing gsal bar snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyi don rnams de dag tu gsungs pa ltar bshad par bya'o/ /de la ting nge 'dzin gyi sdud byed ni/

mdo dgongs 'grel dang / sgom rim bar mar zhi lhag yin par bshad/ dper na ljon shing yal 'dab mang yang sdong po'i rtsa bar 'du ba ltar ro/ /'o na theg pa che chung gi ting nge 'dzin dmigs bcas dmigs med kyi rnam grangs du ma dang / sngags phyogs la mtshan bcas mtshan med du ma dang / phyag chen pa'i bde gsal mi rtogs ting nge 'dzin du ma zhig 'char ba rnams zhi lhag du ji ltar bsdud snyam na/ de dag gang yin kyang rung ste/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu 'jug pa yang zhi gnas dang phyogs mthun zhing / de'i don so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab dge ba rnams lhag mthong dang phyogs mthun te/ theg chen la dad pa bsgom pa'i mdo dang / sgom rim tha mar yang bshad do/ /gnyis pa la/ zhi lhag thun mong gi rnam bzhag dang / zhi lhag so so'i sgom rim gnyis las/ dang po la zhi lhag gi rgyu bstan pa/ zhi lhag gi sgrib pa spang ba/ zhi lhag gi ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ zhi lhag gi dbye ba bstan pa/ zhi lhag gi go rim la dpyad pa/ zhi lhag zung 'jug tu sgom tshul/ zhi lhag gi 'bras bu bshad pa dang bdun gyi/ dang po ni/ dgongs 'grel pa/ tshul khrims dang thos bsam gyi lta ba rnam par dag par rgyud bshad/ gzhan yang bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / rten 'brel dang / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs/ mthun pa'i yul la gnas pa/ 'dod chung chog shes/ bya ba mang po spang ba sogs mang du bshad/ gnyis pa zhi lhag gi sgrib pa spang ba la/ sgrib pa ngos bzung ste spong byed kyi gnyen po bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgongs 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das sgrib pa lnga po gang dag lags pa de dag las du ni zhi gnas kyi sgrib pa lags/ du ni lhag mthong gi sgrib pa lags/ du ni gnyis ka'i sgrib pa lags/ byams pa rgod pa dang 'gyod pa ni zhi gnas kyi sgrib pa yin no/ /rmugs pa dang gnyid dang the tshom ni lhag mthong gi sgrib pa yin no/ /'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems ni gnyis ka'i sgrib pa yin no/

/zhes so/ /kun btus dang mdzod 'grel du rgyas par bshad do/ /gzhan yang rnam g.yeng mtshan 'dzin/ snyoms 'jug ro myang gnas ngan len sogs mang ngo / /dbus mthar nyes pa lnga bshad/ de spang ba la gnyen po 'du byed brgyad do/ /slob dpon blo brtan gyi lus kyi rang gi bya ba rnams la ldang ba yang ba gang las su rung ba'o/ /sems las su rung ba ni/ yang dag par yid la byed pa la zhugs pa'i sems kyi sim pa dang / yang bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu sems las su rung ba'i chos gzhan du gyur pa gang yin pa ste/ de dag dang ldan na dmigs pa la thogs pa med par 'jug pas de'i phyir sems las su rung ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i thog ma nyid nas shin sbyangs rdzogs par thob pa mi 'byung mod kyang / 'bad rtsol gyi cha shas tsam thob pa de rim pas sbyangs nas byang ba na shin sbyangs thob par 'gyur la/ de yang thog mar sems kyi shin sbyangs thob pa'i mthus lus shin sbyangs thob pa'i rgyur gyur pas rlung lus la rgyu zhing / des lus la khyab pa na lus shin sbyangs thob par nyan par bshad/ dran shes dngos 'dzin rgyas par/ kun btus dang / dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du'o/ /gang ltar dran rgyun bskyangs pa las de'i khongs nas yin min brtag cing bsrung ba'i bya ra thu re byed de/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dran pa'i sogs/ bying rgod bral nas zhi lhag cha snyoms na rnal du phab pa ste de la glod de 'jog mkhas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bying rgod skye ba'i rgyu spong ba dang / bying rgod 'gog tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrib pa phal cher bying rgod gnyis su 'du/ de sgo gsum gyi spyod lam ma dag pa dang / zas tshod mi zin pa dang / nam gyi cha stod smad la mi snyom pa'i sbyor ba la mi brtson pa/ gnas min/ gti mug gnyid che thabs mi shes le lo sogs yin par sa'i dngos gzhir bshad/

gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rags pa de dag 'gog la/ snang ba'i mtshan ma dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yid la byed pa/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi dpyod pa/ dmigs pa rgya bskyed gzengs bstod sogs bya bar sgom rim dang por bshad/ snang ba'i mtshan ma ni nyan sar mar me'i 'od las sam/ me'i phung po'i 'od las sam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba'i mtshan ma gzung shig ces pa ltar de dag gi 'od kyi thams cad snang zhing gsal bar gyur pa la sems gtad pa'o/ /gzhan yang phar phyin bsdus pa/ dbu ma snying po/ sgom rim dang po na gsal lo/ /gsum pa zhi lhag gi ngo bo ngos gzung ba ni/ dgongs 'grel/ dkon mchog sprin/ mdo sde rgyan/ de'i 'grel pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ byang sa sogs na gsal lo/ /mdo phyogs ltar na zhi lhag mtshan nyid pa ni/ shin sbyangs thob pa dang rgyun du rang gi 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas 'jog par sgom rim bar mar bshad/ 'o na shin sbyangs ma thob pa'i zhi lhag la ji skad brjod ce na/ zhi lhag rjes mthun pa'i tha snyad dgongs 'grel dang sher phyin man ngag las bshad/ 'o na ci tsam gyi zhi lhag gi lam yongs su dag par 'gyur zhe na/ rmugs gnyid choms pa na zhi gnas dang / rgod 'gyod choms pa na lhag mthong gi lam dag par dgongs 'grel las bshad/ bzhi pa zhi lhag gi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ zhi gnas kyi dbye ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas gnyis dang / byed las kyi sgo nas phye na/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i zhi gnas sogs gsungs yod kyang / mdo rgyan rtsa 'grel las 'jog thabs rnam dgu bshad/ lhag mthong gi dbye ba ni/ dgongs 'grel las/ mtshan ma las su rung ba dang / yongs su tshol ba las byung ba dang so sor rtog pa las byung ba gsum bshad/ kun btus dang / nyan sa sogs nas du ma bshad do/ /lnga pa zhi lhag gi go rim la dpyad pa ni/

mdo phyogs kyi gzhung phal cher du thog mar zhi gnas sgrub la de nas lhag mthong sgrub par bshad pa mang ste/ mdo sde rgyan/ bshes spring / spyod 'jug nyan sa sgom rim/ sher phyin man ngag sogs las so/ /de kho na ltar bzhed pa yod kyang shin sbyangs ma thob pa'ang yod la/ des na rim can du 'jug pa'i gang zag la dgongs pa yin te/ zhi gnas ma thob kyang lhag mthong thob pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de lhar yang kun btus su/ la la ni lhag mthong thob pa yin gyi zhi gnas ni ma thob ste/ de ltar lhag mthong la brten nas zhi gnas la brtson par byed do/ /zhes dang / sa'i dngos gzhir yang bshad do/ /rgyud sde dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung mtha' dag las/ thun stod la mtshan bcas dang thun smad la mtshan med sgom par bshad pa rnams kyang dang por zhi gnas grub nas de grub pa na lhag mthong sgrub pa'i tshul min pa dang / grub chen mang pos kyang zhi gnas zur du mi tshol bar thog ma nyid nas lhag mthong sgom par bshad pa mang du yod pa dang sgrub rgyud pa dag lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba dang sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /drug pa zhi lhag zung 'jug tu sgom tshul la/ zhi lhag gnyis ka dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / de gnyis zung du 'jug tshul gnyis kyi/ dang po ni zhi gnas med na sems g.yo zhing yang dag pa'i don mi thob/ zhi gnas dang bral ba'i lhag mthong yang rlung nang mar me bzhin mi brtan/ yang lhag mthong med pa'i zhi gnas kyi nyon mongs pa bag nyal mi choms pa sogs sgom rim dang dgongs 'grel sogs las bshad/ de gnyis ka dgos pa ni zla ba sgron mer/ zhi gnas stobs kyi g.yo ba med par 'gyur/ /lhag mthong gis ni ri dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni zung 'jug tshul ji ltar dgos snyam na/ sems gnas dgu pa ma thob par/ lhag mthong sgom na'ang so so'i zung du 'jug tshul re yod kyang 'dir mthar thug pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug tu 'gyur tshul ni/

sems gnas dgu la mnyam par 'jog pa'i zhi gnas de byings rgod kyi skyon dang bral ba thob pa na/ de la brten nas chos rnam 'byed kyi lhag mthong la brtson par byas pa'i tshe/ lhag mthong de la'ang rang gi ngang gis 'jug cing sems gnas dgu pa bzhin du 'du byed mi dgos par rtsol med du song nas/ lhag mthong yang rnam par dag pa dang byang bar 'gyur te/ sems gnas dang lhan cig tu 'dres nas mnyam du 'jug pa ni zhi lhag zung 'jug tu gyur ba yin te/ nyan sar/ de la ji tsam gyis sogs nas/ 'brel bar 'jug pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /sgom rim tha mar/ ji ste sogs/ sher phyin man ngag tu de'i 'og tu sogs/ zhi gnas chos gang yang mi rtog pa dang / lhag mthong rtog pa kho nar 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ de ltar na bskyed rim sogs mtshan bcas kyi zhi gnas mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /lhag mthong la'ang sgom rim du mi g.yo'i lhag mthong bshad do/ /de na spyir btang ngo / /ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad do/ /bdun pa zhi lhag gi 'bras bu ni/ dgongs 'grel las de dag gi 'bras bu'i yang gang lags shes bgyi/ sems rnam par dag pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /shes rab rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /zhes pa zhi lhag rim par ro/ /yang der mtshan ma dang gnas ngan len gyi 'ching ba las grol bar bshad/ sdud par/ bsam gtan gyi ni sogs/ bshes spring du/ 'dod spyod dga' dang sogs/ byang chub lam sgron las/ rnal 'byor zhi sogs/ lhag mthong ni/ sdud par/ sangs rgyas sras sogs/ shes rab kyis ni sogs/ mthar thug rdzogs byang ste/ byang sar/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bsam gtan sogs/ sher phyin bdun brgya par/ 'jam dpal shes rab kyi sogs/ de dag ni zhi lhag thun mong gi rnam gzhag go /gnyis pa/ zhi lhag so so'i sgom rim la/ zhi gnas kyi sgom rim/ lhag mthong gi sgom rim/ lta sgom skyong tshul gyi dgos gcod gsum las/ dang po la zhi gnas sgrub pa'i sbyor ba/

dmigs pa'i rnam gzhag zhi gnas sgrub tshul gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i spang bya rnams spangs te bsam gtan gyi chos bdun ldan sogs sdug bsngal dang len sogs kyis bsgrub dgos te/ lam sgron las/ zhi gnas yan lag sogs/ sgom rim dang por zhi gnas la sogs/ bdun pa la dmigs pa spyi'i rnam bzhag gang gi gang la dmigs tshul/ thog pa'i dmigs pa bshad pa dran shes kyi dmigs pa skyong tshul dang bzhi'i/ dang po la khyab pa'i dmigs pa/ spyad pa rnam sbyong gi mkhas pa'i/ nyon mongs rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa bzhi'i dang po ni dmigs pa phyi ma gsum dmigs tshul gyi bye brag zhig yin la/ 'di la phye na bzhi yod pa las rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs pa ni/ gtso bor lhag mthong gi dmigs pa yin yang / 'dir ni mtshan bcas bsgom pa'i mtshan ma la bya'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs pa ni/ dmigs pa la sems gtad nas dpyod byed kyi rnam rtog med par 'jog pa'o/ /gzugs brnyan zhes pa ni gang la dmigs pa'i dmigs yul rang tshor pa de nyid dngos ma yin par de rnam pa blo la snang ba la bshad do/ /dngos po'i mtha' la dmigs pa ni ji lta ba 'di kho na ltar gnas kyi sogs lhag mthong gi dmigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni chags sogs sngar spyad sbyang ba dang phyis mi ldang ba'i dmigs pa khyad par can yin la 'di la lnga yod pa ni/ mi sdug pa/ byams pa/ rten 'brel/ khams kyi rab dbye/ dbugs 'byung rngub bo/ /gsum pa ni phung khams sogs las ma gtogs pa'i gang zag gi bdag 'gog nus pa'i dmigs pa khyad par can te 'di la'ang lnga/ phung khams/ skye mched/ rten 'brel gnas dang gnas min la mkhas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni nyon mongs pa spyi'i gnyen por 'gro ba'i dmigs pa ste/ 'di gnyis zhi rags dang bden bzhi la'o/ /'di dag lhag mthong thun mong ba yin kyang gtso che ba'i dbang gi zhi gnas kyi skabs su bshad do/

/zhi gnas kyi dmigs par byed pa la ni dang por dmigs yul de dag dmigs nas de dag gi rnam par shar ba la/ sems kyi nges pa gang yang rung ba zhig gi sgo nas rtog dpyad gzhan med par sems 'dzin par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni spyad pa rnams sbyangs la/ 'dod chags pa yin na mi sdug pa bsgom pa sogs nam gru'i zhus pa'i mdo nyan sar drangs so/ /mkhas pa'i dmigs pa la gang zag gang gi dmigs pa ni/ mdo de nyid du phung khams la dmigs par 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs rnams sbyongs la'ang zhi rag sogs/ cha mnyam gang rung la sems bzung bas chog par bshad/ gsum pa ni sngar bshad pa'i dmigs pa'i rnam grangs de dag las thog mar gang la dmigs pa bya snyam na/ gang zag rang rang gi so so'i dmigs pa la bya gsungs pa yin yang rnam rtog shas che na rlung sogs thog mar sems 'dzin yan lag gcig kho na la brten dgos par/ jo bos lam sgron dang / dpa' bos bshad/ thog ma'i dmigs brten ni ma nges ci rigs bshad de/ slob dpon byang bzang gis/ kha nang ltas/ phyi ltas gnyis/ nang ltas lus dang lus la brten pa la dmigs pa/ lus la lha dang keng rus sogs/ lus la brten pa'ang dbugs dang / mtshan ma phra mo sogs/ kha phyir bltas/ phal pa rde'u sogs/ dag sku sogs bshad/ bsgom rim phal cher du sku kho na bshad pa bsod nams che bas so/ /gcig la brten nas gzhan la spro bar bshad/ bzhi pa ni ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa la shin tu gnad che ba dran shes so/ /bsgrim lhod ran dgos so/ /gsum pa zhi gnas sgrub tshul la/ 'du byed brgyad kyi sems gnas sgrub tshul/ sems gnas dgu'i rim pas sgrub tshul/ sems gnas de dag stobs drug gi sgrub tshul/ de dag yid byed bzhi yod tshul la/ dang po ni/ dbus mthar/ der gnas las su rung ba nyid sogs/ gnyis pa ni rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas sogs/ gsum pa stobs drug ni/ thos bsam/ dran shes/ brtson 'dri stobs zhes so/

/bzhi pa yid byed bzhi ni/ bsgrims/ mas chad/ chad med/ lhun grub 'jug de dag nyan par bshad/ zhi gnas sgrub tshul la/ g.yeng ba dang 'dres na/ lo stong phrag tu mi 'grub pa dang / rgyu tshogs bsten pa brtson pas rgyun chags su bskyed na ring po mi thogs so/ /zhi gnas kyi sgom rim cung zad bshad zin to// //gnyis pa lhag mthong gi sgom rim la/ lhag mthong spyi'i sgom tshul dang / lhag mthong gi lta ba bskyed tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir lhag mthong la 'jig rten pa'i lhag mthong / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang dman pa'i lhag mthong / theg chen pa'i lhag mthong gsum las/ snga ma ni zhi rags kyi rnam pa la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong / bar ma ni bden bzhi la dmigs nas gtso bor gang zag gi bdag 'gog pa'i lhag mthong yin/ phyi ma ni 'dir bsgom par bya ba'i lhag mthong yin no/ /dgongs 'grel dang nyan sar dbye ba du ma gsungs so/ /rgyan du yid kyi brjod pa rgyun chags su/ /zhes sogs kyi 'grel par/ dbyig gnyen gyi yid byed bcu gcig bstan te lhag mthong gi tshul bcu gcig bshad de/ snga ma rnams lta ba 'tshol ba bar pa rnams lta ba bsgom ba/ phyi ma rnams lta ba la nan tan byed pa'i lhag mthong gi rnam bzhag go /mdor na mdo dang sgom rim rnams su/ shing gnyis rtsub pa las me 'byung ba'i dpes/ sbyar ba'i dus su rtog dpyod kyi shes rab/ mthar shing de yang me de nyid kyi bsregs nas me dang shing gnyis ka zhi ba'i dpes lhag mthong gi dngos gzhi'i skabs su rtog brjod sogs kyang mi dmigs par bshad/ gnyis pa la byams pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul/ klu sgrub kyi lugs la thal rang gi 'dod tshul sogs gzhan du gsal/ dka' gnas cung zad bris na/ don la gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad rang gi sems snang tsam du thag chod cing / rang sems kyi don dam pa'i gnas tshul de nyid kyang gdod ma nas gang gi yang rang bzhin du ma grub pa/

dngos po dang mtshan mas ma gos pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ rtag dpyad kyi blo'i yul las 'das pa/ ngos zung dang bral ba rgyun chad pa med pa/ dper na nam mkha' lta bu la/ 'on kyang las dang po pa la sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams myong dang dran rig phra mo khyad par du byas pa tsam zhig go yul du ma lus pa/ nyams myong gi thog nas rig cing gtan la phab pa ni yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /lhag mthong gi sgom rim bshad zin to// //gsum pa lta sgom skyong tshul gyi dogs dpyod la/ dpyad sgom 'jog sgom gyi rnam dbye/ zhi lhag la dpyad 'jog ji ltar bya ba/ lta ba sgom pa la dpyad 'jog ji ltar bya ba/ lta ba dngos gzhi'i dogs dpyod bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas pa dang ku sā li gnyis ka la'ang gtso bo che chung ma gtogs dpyad 'jog gnyis ka dgos/ de yang rjes dpag mi byed lung rigs kyi dpyad pa zhig dpyad sgom dang / dngos gsum du lam byed mnyam bzhag 'jog sgom mo/ /snga ma ni shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi gzhung la rten pa shas che/ phyi ma bram ze chen po sogs kyi rgyud rim mo/ /gnyis ka'i rnyed don lta ba gnad gcig go /'on kyang lung rigs kyi dpyad gzhi kho nas lta ba rtogs pa ni srid pa tsam mo/ /paṇa grub rnams kyang sngags kyi man ngag la brten pa'i lo rgyus yod pas/ dbu ma'i gzhung gi rigs pa la brten par lta ba mi rtog par smra ba ni mi 'thad do/ /gnyis pa ni zhi lhag gnyis ka la'ang gtso bo che chung ma gtogs dpyad 'jog gnyis ka dgos so/ /zhi lhag 'dres tshe dpyad 'jog spel mi dgos/ gsum pa ni/ lta ba 'tshol ba'i tshe thos bsam gyi shes rab kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la sgro 'dogs bcad na nges shes 'dren pa la khyad par che la/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'tshol ba la ni sgom byung gi so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab gal che ste 'jog sgom dran rgyun ma shor ba las so/ /bzhi pa ni spros pa mang po btang snyoms su byas nas skabs don cung zad brjod na/

stong nyid kyi lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa ni 'phags pa'i sa thob pa na 'byung bar bshad/ so skye'i spyod yul ni sngar bshad pa ltar dpyad 'jog la brten nas stong nyid kyi lta ba rnyed pa'o/ /de dag ni sgom dgos dpyod do/ /gzhan yang gnad don 'gag zhig bsdus pa ni/ mtshan mo la cha gsum du byas pa'i cha stod smad gnyis dran shes dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la brtson 'grus bskyed/ nyal ba'i tshe rkang pa g.yon par g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag nas/ seng ge'i nyal stabs su nyal/ de'i chos nyid kyi lus lhod par mi 'gyur ba dang / gnyid 'thug por mi 'gyur ba dang / gnyid log pa'i tshe'ang dran pa mi brjed pa'ang / rmi lam du sdig pa dang ngan pa mi rmi ba'i gnad yod par bshad/ dran pa ni gnyid du ma song gi bar nyin par gang la ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa de'i dran pa bsten te/ 'dis gnyid log pa'i tshe'ang dge sbyor la 'khrid nus par bshad/ shes bzhin ni dran pa rten tshe nyon mongs sogs skye na shes par byas nas spongs te/ 'dis gnyid dang rmi lam du 'khrul pa chung bar bshad/ gnyid kyis rgyas par byed pa'i 'byung ba 'phel ba'i lus brtas par byed pa tsam gyi phyir du gnyid thum phras tsam zhig log nas/ nangs par yang langs te dge sbyor la brtson par bya'o snyam du 'phen pa btang la/ 'od kyi mtshan ma bskyed nas de la de sems gtad pas gnyid par bya ste/ 'dis sems la mun pa mi 'bab pa dang gnyid srab cing dus la sad pa dang nangs par yang dge sbyor gyi brtson par 'phel bar bshad do/ /sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams re re yang bsod nams brgya snyed pa sgom par bya'o/ /zhes bzang skyong gi mdo las so/ /dran shes gnyis phra rags sam rtsing zhib kyi sgo nas phye ba ste/ dran pa gsal po stobs can gyi khongs su shes bzhin tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang dbus mtha'i 'grel par/

dran pa nye bar gnas pa shes bzhin dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /rtog pa phra mo de rtogs par mtshan ma yin gyi lhag mthong dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes bzhin nam rig pa yin/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa la zhi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sa pa'i tha snyad dang / khams gong ma'i bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sa pa'i tha snyad 'dogs/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i shin sbyangs rim gyis thob/ de thob na zhag mang por ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag kyang de'i tshe lus sems gnyis kyi gnas ngan len rgyun chad nas/ lus sems la bde dga' thob pa dang bcas pas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug nus so/ /'o na sems kyi gnas lugs shes pa la phyi rol gyi snang ba med dam zhe na/ de yang min te/ mig nad dang 'dra ba'i spyi mthun gyi las dang bag chags ma log na mig nad kyi skyon du shes pa dang 'dra ba'i sems kyi 'khrul lugs dang gnas lugs shes pa tsam gyis ldog mi nus te/ birwa pas/ rtog pa'i ngang nas mi gnas mtshan mas g.yengs gyur na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i bag chags ldog par mi 'gyur te/ /rab rib can gyi mig gi nang du shes gyur kyang / /mig gi nad ma byang bar rab rib snang mi ldog /ces so/ /'on kyang sems kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i ji ltar snang ba thams cad kyi snang tshul ma 'gag bzhin du de sems kyi ngo bo dang dbyer med du 'char bar gyur nas gnas 'gyu ngo bo gcig pa'i don chu dang rlabs kyi dpes mtshon nas gnas 'gyu gnyis ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i rang bzhin stong nyid du ro gcig pa la nyams kyi 'gyur ba tha dad du snang ba la bya ste/ rig thog tu gnas 'gyu ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du btags/ so so rang rig gi don mtshan ma med pa dang bsam mi khyab la bshad/ sems nyid dang lhan skyes ngo sprad pa ni/ rang gi sems bying rgod kyi skyon dang bral zhing bzang ngan gyi rtog pas ma slad par rnal du phab la rang babs su bzhag pa'i dus na/

sems de'i gnas lugs sam gnas tshul sems rang gi bltas pa'i tshe rnam par rtog pa'i 'char sgo phra rags thams cad la bkag kyang rang sangs rang dag rang zhi la song nas ngos zung ci yang med pa'i ngang du lhang nge'am/ cham me gnas pa zhig 'byung ba ni sems kyi gnas tshul la sems 'jog pas na zhi gnas zhes bya ba yin la/ de'i ngang nas rig pa mi gsal bar rmongs pa'am dran med kyi lung ma bstan nam btang snyoms su 'phyal bar ma song bar sems kyi ngo bo de gsal la/ ma 'gag par rang rig cing rang gsal bar/ rig lugs dang gsal lugs ji lta ba brjod du med pa/ rnam pa gsum rig pa lta bu'i nyams su myong rgyu'am phrig tshud rgyu cung zad tsam yod pa ni lta bya'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pas na lhag mthong ngo / /pra kri ta rang bzhin dang tha mal gnyis ka la 'jug spyir dmigs gtad thams cad kyi thar pa thob pa'i bgegs byed/ lce sgom pas/ thib bdud mgo la zhugs pa zhes/ dge sbyor gyi nyams mi gsal ba dang / smra bdud lce la zhugs pa zhes smra ba la dga' zhing khyad par nyams myong gsang mi thub pa dang / 'phro bdud snying la zhugs pa zhes shes pa yul 'phro zhing blo rnal du mi phebs pa dang / 'gro bdud rkang pa la zhugs pa zhes dben par sdod mi tshugs par 'gro 'dod pa rnams 'byung ba las rim bzhin bla ma spyi bo dang mgrin pa snying kha rnams su bsgom nas so so'i bgegs zhi bar gsol ba drag po btab pas zhi bar bshad do/ /mdor na lta bsgom gyi yon tan yar 'phel du 'gro ba la gnod na bsod nams skyes pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba'ang mchog grub pa'i bar chad kyi bgegs su bshad pas gnyen po dang lam khyer ci rigs pa'i rkyen sel bar bya'o/ /rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor dang mos gus dag snang snying rje la sogs pa'i thabs kyi cha la khyad du bsod srid pas de dag shugs phyung la bsgom/ rten 'brel bzang po thams cad sgrig pa dang /

ngan pa thams cad spang ba dang / dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin du bya ba gal che/ mdor na re zhig bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por song ma song brtag pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho ljing las legs byung ba'i/ /gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i byi dor gyi/ /rang gzhan phan bde'i dpal gyis 'byor par shog /'di ni bya bral sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis brjed tho'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gnas lugs sgom pa'i lhan thabs yid kyi mun sel bi dza ha ra/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
